title: mentha canadensis subsp. borealis
intro: Mentha canadensis subsp. borealis, commonly known as Canadian wild mint, is a subspecies of the mint plant native to North America. It has been traditionally used for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Canadian wild mint include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which can help to relieve symptoms of respiratory issues such as congestion and coughing. The bioactive constituents of Canadian wild mint include volatile oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
